entities.summary: Christopher Bigras is a Canadian former professional ice hockey defenceman. Bigras was selected by the Colorado Avalanche in the second round of the 2013 NHL Entry Draft. He was born in Orillia, Ontario, but grew up in Elmvale, Ontario.
